name: Starting Shelf Island
desc: a vast dark shelf of rock split down the middle by a deep ravine that is crossed by one colossal fallen bronze beam, at the far end a towering broken gateway of bronze and frozen fire, a tall pointed arch with a single still beam of light standing inside it, a shallow bronze-inlaid arrival disc with concentric rings on the near side, huge cracked paving slabs, thick rusted chains hanging off the rim into the void, a tapering inverted-cone underside like a gigantic dark spearhead with a faint bronze vein glowing deep inside it, one bare dead fossil tree, immense, silent and ominous
short: Ravine, fallen bronze beam, broken gateway of light

dress.name: Fossil Tree
dress.where: one, near the arrival disc side

dress.name: Small Lantern Post
dress.where: a pair flanking the arrival disc

name: Small Stepping Island
desc: a single tall twisted spire of rock like a petrified whirlwind, spiral strata corkscrewing up around its core, a small flat stepping top just wide enough for a person, one bronze ring band wrapped around its waist, jagged stone fins spiralling off the sides, a long drilled-looking tapering tail underneath with small hanging shards, striking and sculptural
short: Twisted whirlwind spire with a bronze ring
note: Sheet v1 filed. The last two cells repeat the labels LEFT SIDE and TOP; they are extra side views. No underside or right view yet.

name: Medium Island with Windbreak
desc: a wind-carved island whose edge sweeps up into a huge natural stone arch bridge spanning a sheltered hollow gully, the hollow floor paved with bronze inlay lines, the outer face of the arch fluted and scoured by wind into long ribbed grooves, a crooked leaning bronze-capped pillar at the mouth of the gully, ragged cliff sides, a ribbed bell-shaped underside with hanging stone tendrils, mysterious like the entrance to something ancient
short: Natural stone arch over a sheltered hollow

name: Large Plateau Island
desc: a vast island dominated by a sunken terraced bowl of concentric collapsed stone rings like a dry ancient reservoir, around the rim a crown of towering broken columns of different heights like the stumps of a giant colonnade, enormous fallen column drums lying across the terraces, two tall stone-and-bronze beacon pillars at the edge of the bowl, broken ragged cliff rim, a deep underside of stacked hanging rock slabs like an upside-down mountain, grand, weathered and mysterious
short: Sunken terraced bowl ringed by broken columns

dress.name: Tower Ruin, Large
dress.where: two on the rim, opposite each other

name: Long Causeway Island
desc: a very long thin island shaped like the spine of a colossal fossil creature, a straight obsidian paving strip running along the top with a bronze inlay line, giant curved stone ribs arching up and over the strip in an uneven rhythm, some ribs snapped off, small vertebra-like knobs along the sides, the underside tapering away like a tail with hanging chains, eerie and monumental
short: Fossil spine with giant arching ribs
note: Sheet v1 filed. One angle in the middle row (a long 3/4 view) has no label, and there is no underside view.

dress.name: Plank and Metal Causeway Segment
dress.where: laid along the path between the ribs

name: Arena Island
desc: a circular ancient stone arena floating in the sky, a massive ring wall broken into jagged tooth-like towers of different heights, a cracked flat floor with five great round vents glowing ember-orange, enormous bronze braziers on the ring wall, thick chains attached to two sides as bridge anchors, a stepped funnel-shaped underside like a gigantic inverted bowl with a dull glowing ember core deep in its base, as in the Stage 3 key art, intimidating and grand
short: Tooth-ring arena, five vents, funnel underside

dress.name: Needle Spire Tower
dress.where: one on the far side, as a landmark

name: Summit Peak Island
desc: the tallest floating island, a slender mountain spire of dark weathered stone spiralled by one long carved staircase winding up around it, narrow bronze-edged terraces at each turn, hanging chains and broken stone arches along the climb, the top ending in a wide flat crown platform ringed by jagged broken stone teeth and left empty for a monumental throne, the base a long tapering root of rock, wreathed in cloud, awe-inspiring and austere
short: Spire wound by one long staircase, empty crown
note: Sheet v1 plus six single-angle renders filed. Still needed: underside and 3/4 front-left.

dress.name: Summit Staircase
dress.where: the long carved stair around the spire

dress.name: Peak Column
dress.where: at the crown, beside the empty Throne space

dress.name: Gatehouse Tower
dress.where: one at the stair mid-point, as a landmark

name: Canyon Cliff Pair
desc: two colossal sheer cliff islands that look like the two halves of one split mountain, their layered strata lines matching across the gap as though torn apart, one cliff with a huge dark cave mouth, the other with a toppled bronze arch hanging from its edge by chains, bronze anchor plates set into the near edges, jagged shattered faces, hanging stone teeth below, dramatic and ominous
short: Two halves of one split mountain, cave and toppled arch

dress.name: Fixed Stone Bridge
dress.where: across the gap between the two cliffs

dress.name: Twin Towers with Broken Arch
dress.where: one set on the cave-side cliff top

name: Drifting Fragment Cluster
desc: a loose constellation of six very different broken fragments floating at different heights: a floating stone arch, a broken tower tip with bronze windows, a split hollow sphere of rock, a tilted slab with a staircase carved into it, a jagged crystal-like obsidian blade cluster, and a stout rounded boulder with a bronze band, thin amber light glowing in their cracks, no connections, mysterious like the wreckage of a giant structure
short: Six different wreck fragments

name: Debris Rocks Set
desc: a set of four floating debris rocks, each a different shape: a spiral shard, a hollow ring-shaped stone, a cluster of obsidian blades, and a rounded boulder with a bronze band, jagged tan fracture faces, small bronze flecks, thin amber glow in the cracks
short: Four distinct debris rocks

dress.name: Rock Spire Cluster
dress.where: a small one on the largest rock

name: Moving Platform Slab
desc: a heavy carved floating stone slab with a thick bronze rim, deep straight glowing amber guide channels cut across its top in parallel lines, chamfered edges, bronze ring handles hanging from its sides on short chains, a visible bronze piston-and-rail mechanism fixed beneath it, ancient engineered machinery
short: Heavy slab on a visible piston and rail

dress.name: Anchor Socket
dress.where: at each end of the rail

name: Brittle Slab
desc: a fragile floating slab of thin layered stone peeling apart in sheets, hairline cracks leaking thin amber light, bronze inlay partly broken, chipped edges, small fragments already drifting off its rim, a delicate and doomed look
short: Layered slab peeling apart, leaking amber light

name: Windbreak Ridge
desc: a tall curved blade of obsidian-black rock like a giant shark fin or scimitar rising from a flat base, its wind-carved face fluted with long smooth grooves, a notched crest, a tiny ruined stair cut along the rough back, a few bronze brackets bolted into it
short: Shark-fin blade ridge with a tiny stair

dress.name: Signal Mast
dress.where: one at the top of the tiny stair

name: Tower Ruin, Large
desc: a colossal tapering tower ruin of dark weathered stone stacked in seven narrowing tiers, each tier ringed by a gold-bronze band and carved vertical panels, tall arched windows with a faint amber glow, flying stone buttress arches clinging to its flanks, a deep crack running down one side, the top sheared off in a jagged diagonal break that exposes the inner floors, grand and ominous
short: Seven-tier tapering tower, sheared top

name: Tower Ruin, Capped
desc: a squat massive round drum tower with an intact domed bronze cap weathered green with verdigris and topped by a bronze finial spike, a carved stone spiral stair wrapping around its outside, three gold-bronze bands, small arched windows with a faint amber glow, heavy and ancient
short: Squat drum tower, verdigris dome, spiral stair

name: Rock Spire Cluster
desc: seven jagged natural needles of obsidian-black rock with tan edges rising from one shared base, one very tall central needle with a leaning sister beside it, a small carved stone balcony fused halfway up the tallest, fractured horizontal strata, dramatic, sharp and mysterious
short: Seven black needles with a fused balcony

name: Monolith Slab
desc: a single tall rectangular monolith slab leaning very slightly, obsidian-black, smooth faces with one cracked corner, a thin vertical bronze inlay line running its full height, set in a low square stone footing
short: Slightly leaning obsidian monolith

name: Locked Bronze Gate
desc: a tall ornate double door set in a carved stone frame, green-bronze (verdigris) panels with scrollwork, a heavy chain and padlock across the center, a thin bright amber light leaking through the center crack
short: A tall ornate double door set in a carved stone frame

name: Fixed Stone Bridge
desc: a narrow arched stone bridge of weathered dark blocks with a bronze keystone and low side curbs, worn surface, anchored at both ends into rock
short: A narrow arched stone bridge of weathered dark blocks

name: Plank and Metal Causeway Segment
desc: a short walkway segment of weathered wooden planks fixed between heavy metal chains and bronze posts, sturdy and fixed in place, as seen on the plank bridges in the key art
short: A short walkway segment of weathered wooden planks fixed between heavy metal cha

name: Light Bridge Segment
desc: a short ladder-style chain bridge segment: two heavy chains with flat wooden rungs, where the front rungs are glowing bright amber light bars and the rest are plain weathered wood, as in the key art
short: A short ladder-style chain bridge segment: two heavy chains

name: Anchor Socket
desc: a round bronze meditation disc set flush in worn paving, several concentric etched rings with fine engraved patterns, a small recessed center; shown dormant (and a second version softly glowing amber)
short: A round bronze meditation disc set flush in worn paving

name: Ignition Column, Dormant
desc: a tall slim carved stone column on a round bronze base, vertical bronze inlay channels, flat top with a small dark fire bowl, shown dormant and unlit
short: A tall slim carved stone column on a round bronze base

name: Ignition Column, Ignited
desc: the same tall slim carved stone column on a round bronze base with a controlled straight vertical column of amber fire rising from its top bowl, bronze channels glowing amber
short: The same tall slim carved stone column on a round bronze base

name: Peak Column
desc: a wide fluted dark-stone column with a bronze capital, standing alone at a summit, shown dormant
short: A wide fluted dark-stone column

name: Lantern Anchor XL, Hanging
desc: a monumental hanging lantern, clean geometric aged-bronze frame around a hollow core, suspended from a heavy bracket, shown dark and dormant
short: A monumental hanging lantern

name: Lantern Anchor XL, Tower-Mounted
desc: a monumental lantern mounted on top of a carved stone tower base, clean geometric aged-bronze frame, hollow core, shown dark and dormant
short: A monumental lantern mounted on top of a carved stone tower base

name: Lantern Anchor XL, Ground
desc: a monumental ground-standing lantern on a wide stepped stone base, geometric bronze cage, hollow core, shown dormant
short: A monumental ground-standing lantern on a wide stepped stone base

name: Lantern Anchor XL, Lit
desc: the same monumental geometric bronze lantern with steady stable amber fire inside its core, warm light spilling onto the base
short: The same monumental geometric bronze lantern

name: Heat Vent
desc: a round floor heat vent with a raised bronze rim and radial slots, obsidian paving around it, faint amber glow inside
short: A round floor heat vent

name: Energy Reservoir
desc: a shallow round basin of obsidian stone with bronze rim holding glowing amber energy liquid, stepped sides
short: A shallow round basin of obsidian stone

name: Fossil Tree
desc: a dry dead tree, bare twisted pale-brown trunk with many thin bare branching limbs, petrified, no leaves, as scattered across the key-art islands
short: A dry dead tree

name: Signal Mast
desc: a tall thin dark-bronze mast pole with five short horizontal cross-arms of different lengths, the tip of each arm glowing amber, set on a small round bronze base
short: A tall thin dark-bronze mast pole

name: Small Lantern Post
desc: a small bronze lantern on a short post with a flame-lit glass-free cage, warm amber glow, placed along bridge paths
short: A small bronze lantern on a short post

name: Summit Staircase
desc: a broad weathered stone staircase of many wide flat steps climbing a rocky summit in zig-zag flights with landings, eroded edges
short: A broad weathered stone staircase of many wide flat steps climbing a rocky summi

name: Leaning Broken Tower
desc: a tall square tower ruin tilted at a dramatic angle as if caught mid-fall, held up by one thick bronze-banded stone buttress, the upper floors snapped and hanging off by heavy chains, dark weathered stone with carved panels, gaping arched windows with a faint amber glow, tense and mysterious
short: Tower tilted mid-fall, chains and buttress

name: Needle Spire Tower
desc: an impossibly slender needle tower of dark stone, a narrow carved lantern chamber near the top, tiny arched windows, a single thread of gold-bronze inlay running its whole height, tapering to a razor-sharp point, standing alone and awe-inspiring
short: Impossibly slender 45 m needle tower

name: Twin Towers with Broken Arch
desc: two matching carved ruin towers of different heights, one with a bronze dome cap and one open-topped, joined near the top by a high stone arch bridge that is cracked and missing its middle section, gold-bronze bands, small amber-lit windows, grand and silent
short: Twin towers joined by a broken arch

name: Gatehouse Tower
desc: a broad fortress gatehouse tower with a huge pointed arch passage through its base, deep shadow inside, flanking carved guardian pilasters, empty bronze track grooves where a portcullis once hung, a stone crown of broken battlement teeth, weathered dark stone with gold-bronze trim, ruin not a city
short: Gatehouse with a huge arch passage

name: Six-Line Ladder, Dormant
desc: six long straight horizontal cylindrical rods with small metal end caps, stacked vertically with even spacing, parallel and equal in length, floating; shown unlit as dark bronze rods; flat straight bars only, not a star shape, not a circle
short: Six long straight horizontal cylindrical rods

name: Six-Line Ladder, Progress States
desc: six equal straight horizontal bars stacked vertically; show three versions side by side: bottom bar glowing warm amber-white, bottom four glowing, all six glowing; unlit bars thin and dark; flat straight bars only
short: Six equal straight horizontal bars stacked vertically; show three versions side

name: Fire Eye Structure
desc: a huge eye of living fire floating in the sky, an almond-shaped eyelid ring of flaming amber tendrils and radiating fire filaments, a fiery amber iris with a dark vertical diamond-shaped pupil, perfectly symmetrical, as in the key art
short: A huge eye of living fire floating in the sky

name: Ringed Planet
desc: a large distant ringed planet, warm sepia and tan bands, thin pale ring, soft glow, as in the key-art cover
short: A large distant ringed planet

name: Plain Planet
desc: a distant cratered brown-amber planet with a dark terminator shadow, no rings, soft rim glow, as in the key-art cover
short: A distant cratered brown-amber planet

name: The Throne of Stillness
desc: a colossal ancient throne hewn from black volcanic stone and aged bronze, about 40 m tall, unmistakably a throne: a deep massive seat block with two thick armrests, and rising far above it a very tall narrow monolith backrest with straight parallel sides and a flat notched top, six equally spaced horizontal glowing amber fissures carved across the backrest like a ladder of fire, hot molten-amber cracks veining through the dark stone like lava under a crust, two colossal curved bronze dragon ribs rising on either side and arching inward like a cage with fire glowing between them, a long steep staircase of broken black stone with bronze braziers burning along both sides leading up to the seat, heavy rough weathered surfaces, thin embers rising
note: Sheet v1 approved as the look reference. Revision needed on the final: six fissures (sheet shows five) and two large dragon ribs (sheet shows many tusk-like ribs); the throne should also read taller against the staircase.
short: A colossal ancient throne hewn from black volcanic stone and aged bronze

name: The Throne Stairs and Platform
desc: a long steep staircase of broken black volcanic stone with bronze braziers burning along both sides, leading up to a broad flat cracked stone platform with thin molten-amber veins in the stone, heavy rough weathered surfaces
short: A long steep staircase of broken black volcanic stone

name: Throne on Summit
desc: the colossal ancient volcanic-stone Throne with its very tall six-fissure monolith backrest and two arching bronze dragon ribs, standing at the very top of a rocky summit island above the clouds, the long staircase of broken black stone with burning bronze braziers climbing up to it
short: The colossal ancient volcanic-stone Throne

name: The Cinder (guide)
desc: a small floating faceted polyhedron fire construct about the size of a head, gold-bronze angular frame with glass-like triangular and hexagonal facets around a bright glowing ember core with a faint engraved symbol, no face, no limbs
short: A small floating faceted polyhedron fire construct about the size of a head

name: Fire Dragon
desc: a colossal winged fire dragon matching the key art: dark scaled body cracked with glowing amber-ember seams, large membrane wings with ember-lit veins, spiked head ridge and jaw glowing with amber fire, long body, majestic and calm, shown flying
short: A colossal winged fire dragon matching the key art: dark scaled body cracked

name: Glass Shadow
desc: a tall humanoid figure made of faceted transparent amber-gold glass crystal, smooth faceless head, fine crack lines across the body, small glowing shards breaking off at one arm, symbolic force not a person
short: A tall humanoid figure made of faceted transparent amber-gold glass crystal

name: Burn Knight
desc: a heavy armored figure in dark matte black-bronze plate armor with amber-glowing visor and shoulder studs, a large round shield on one arm with a glowing swirling amber heat core, helmet without horns, symbolic force not a person
short: A heavy armored figure in dark matte black-bronze plate armor

name: Ember Leech
desc: a long armored centipede-like creature, dark segmented plates, many thin legs, curved pincer tail with a glowing molten-ember sac at the rear, clinging to a stone ledge
short: A long armored centipede-like creature

name: Storm Wraith (VFX reference)
desc: a large humanoid figure formed of dark swirling dust and storm cloud, long clawed hands, faint amber lightning veins running through it, no solid face, shown mid-stride
short: A large humanoid figure formed of dark swirling dust and storm cloud
